note: Fri 21 Aug 10:10 SGT — THURSDAY 20 AUGUST complete in both Asia and the US; this is a TWO-SESSION CATCH-UP (last full refresh covered through Tue 18 Aug). WED 19 AUG: US Treasury doubled its long-end debt-buyback operation size (to >=$4bn/op for 10-30y, effective 9 Sep) after the 30Y touched a post-2007 high (~5.33%) — pulled the 10Y to 4.647% and 30Y to 5.196%, sent DXY to an 11-week low, and ignited a REAL precious-metals breakout: GLD +3.84% to 415.26, SLV +4.47% to 60.01, GC=F +2.83%, SI=F +2.80%, with miners leading on operating leverage (GDX +9.42% to 97.33, SILJ +9.55%, Barrick +8.82%). July FOMC minutes (also Wed) showed 3-of-12 dissenting for a hike — hawkish, but overwhelmed by the buyback relief. Nikkei -3.16% and KOSPI -5.80% Wed on an AI/chip-valuation unwind (Nvidia lost as much as ~$600bn intraday on 'circular financing' fears) that hit Samsung/SK Hynix hardest. THU 20 AUG: blockbuster US data (jobless claims 206K vs 210K fcst; Philly Fed mfg 47.4 vs 24.1 fcst) plus a hawkish Musalem ('won't prejudge September', inflation 2.5-3% vs 2% target) trimmed near-term Fed-cut odds and drove a genuine equity selloff — S&P 7,641.16 (-0.87%), Nasdaq 26,067.17 (-1.00%), Dow 52,759.21 (-1.32%), Russell 2,992.43 (-1.34%), VIX 16.01 (+7.52%) — even as gold/silver kept grinding higher (GLD +0.34%, SLV +2.75%, SI=F +4.38%) on the still-easier real-yield/dollar backdrop; miners decelerated (GDX +2.59%, SILJ +0.67%) as equity-market risk-off capped their equity beta. KOSPI ROUND-TRIPPED +5.89% Thu — Samsung's >KRW100tn shareholder-return plan and SK Hynix's KRW40tn buyback/cancellation reversed almost all of Wed's crash; Nikkei +1.36% partially recovered; HSI +0.80% (calmer, Tencent/Xiaomi up, SMIC down). Brent/WTI kept grinding higher (+2.29%/+1.05% Thu) on the unresolved Strait of Hormuz crisis. RARE EARTH: MP -2.89% Thu (sector-wide AI-fear profit-taking, not company news — Q2 fundamentals were a beat); Energy Fuels -6.40% same read. BITCOIN: +7.09% Wed, continuing to a ~$74,859 Fri-AM level (+8.07%, crypto trades continuously so this is a LEVEL not a close) on the same debasement/buyback narrative plus a record ~$2.7-3bn short-liquidation cascade and Trump crypto-reserve talk. HOLDINGS Thu close: Tencent 451.40 (+0.94%), Xiaomi 27.76 (+1.17%), SMIC 72.10 (-1.23%); DBS 75.84 (-0.21%), OCBC 30.78 (-0.52%).

flows.narrative: The week through 19 Aug showed a decisive rotation into safe-haven/defensive assets: money-market/cash funds drew the largest inflow ($25.4bn), bonds $23.8bn, and gold $6.3bn — its biggest weekly inflow since January 2026 — as BofA's Michael Hartnett reiterated a 'long gold, short USD' stance. Equities still drew a net $16.1bn but this was a slowdown versus prior weeks, consistent with the tech-led deleveraging that JPMorgan separately flagged as still-unresolved since June and that hit semis hardest in the Aug 19 rout.
